s1.syndrome_frame: Pregnant woman with acute respiratory illness and signs of severe infection
salient_findings: Respiratory distress with increased respiratory rate and low oxygen saturation
Hemodynamic instability with elevated blood pressure
key_facts: 17-year-old pregnant woman at 33 weeks and 4 days gestation
Carrying twins with estimated body weights of 1900 g and 2000 g
No significant medical history
No vaccination history during pregnancy
Initial temperature of 39.2°C
Initial pulse of 129 beats per minute
Initial respiratory rate of 22 breaths per minute
Initial blood pressure of 130/81 mm Hg
Cervix dilated to 3 cm on later examination
White blood cell count of 13.4 × 10⁹/L
Platelet count of 139 × 10⁹/L
Hemoglobin of 112 g/L
Hemoculture showed no pathogens grown
Chest radiograph showed patchy infiltrates in the upper and middle lobes of the right lung
Real-time PCR of lung and heart tissue was positive for influenza A (H3N2) virus

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, such as fever, cough, and sore throat, along with the positive real-time PCR of lung and heart tissue for influenza A (H3N2) virus, strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pneumococcal pneumonia
rejected.why: No pathogens were grown in hemoculture, and the patient's symptoms and laboratory results do not specifically point to pneumococcal pneumonia.

rejected.label: Staphylococcal pneumonia
rejected.why: There is no evidence of Staphylococcus infection in the patient's laboratory results or symptoms.

rejected.label: COVID-19
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and positive real-time PCR for influenza A (H3N2) virus do not support a diagnosis of COVID-19.

rejected.label: Varicella pneumonia
rejected.why: There is no mention of a varicella infection or symptoms consistent with varicella pneumonia in the patient's presentation or laboratory results.
